links.reason: Both turn on the moon's spot (விமலந்தனக்கு இல்லது / திங்கள் மறுவாற்றும்), but the Neelakesi excuses a fault in a poem while the quatrain judges a moral stain in the noble: different domains, not one limiting the other. The epic-side gain, that the apology 'lowers the standard' of the ethics books, overstates a conventional modesty verse.

The shared word is real (மெய்யுணர்வு இன்றி, 286 / மெய்யுணர்வு இல்லாதவர்க்கு), but Manimekalai's argument at 284-285 is that parents are known by அனுமானம், inference, not that sense-knowledge needs spiritual true understanding as in the couplet. Teaches makes her use the couplet's sense/true-understanding contrast, which the lines do not do; the link is at most agreement on a phrase.

அல்லவை செய்தார்க்கு அறங்கூற்றம் ஆம் agrees with the couplet that harm returns on the doer. The qualification rests on reading கடுவினையேன் as the victim naming her own karma (it more naturally means 'I who will do a harsh deed', cf. செய்வதூஉம் காண்) and on the queen's suffering, which this venba does not state; the epic-side gain is trivial.
links.text_issue: Marker flags the venba's sense as uncertain; the addressee/subject of வயவேந்தன் தேவி is ambiguous.

links.reason: The shared count is real (புலம் ஆர் பொருள்கள் இருபத்தைந்து, 233 / இருபத்தஞ்சு), and Tirumular has a maker (ஆக்குகின்றான்) where the Sankhya speaker names none. But the epic's twenty-five end in உயிர் எனும் ஆன்மா, the soul itself, which Tirumular's Lord would then be making, and the Tirumanthiram verse is uncertain; the 'source' claim in gains is asserted, not shown.
links.text_issue: Both ends flagged uncertain by the marker.

links.reason: ஊன்கொண்ட காட்சி முதலாக (9.3) announces the debates beginning with the flesh issue, and 163 opens Neelakesi's charge against the Buddha's way with ஊன்றின்றல் இழுக்கென்னான். A prologue's announcement and its fulfilment, with the note accurate; 163 adds the soul-denial in the same line, so 'ethical before metaphysical' is an order of listing, which teaches fairly claims.

தண்டாமரைமேல் நடந்தான் (3.3) and மலர்மிசை ஏகினான் share the distinctive flower-walking epithet for the god's feet, here in an avowedly Jain context (bowing at his தடந்தாள்). That gives the disputed Kural epithet a sectarian witness, which is a real gain; the epic-side gain is modest but true.

Kannaki's vow at 19.71 (தீவேந்தன் தனைக்கண்டு இத்திறம் கேட்பல்) is carried out when she stands at the gate (வாயிலோயே ... அறிவிப்பாயே). This is close to plain story sequence; the vow-and-keeping is real but the next scene in order is what the plot already records.

Both name Pulli's Venkatam with the same toddy-barter detail (நறவுநொடை, 61.10 and 83.8): in 61 even winning விழவுடை விழுச்சீர் வேங்கடம் would not hold him, in 83 her virtues came though he passed வேங்கடம் கழியினும் சேயர் என்னாது. The two opposite uses are exactly as teaches says.

Both use the fruiting tree as the image of a giver: பயன்மரம் உள்ளூர்ப் பழுத்தற்றால் and கடவுள் ஆலத்துத் தடவுச்சினைப் பல்பழம் to which birds return (நெருநல் உண்டனம் என்னாது). Teaches correctly sets the owner's view against the birds' view and the poem's last lines join giver and asker.

The venba lists dust, loose hair, the lone anklet and tears (கண்ணீரும்) and says sight defeated him and her words took his life; tears are one item of four, while Kural 555 is about subjects' tears under oppression wearing away wealth (தேய்க்கும்). The development is real but the note overstates tears as the agent.

The materialist makes awareness arise in combined elements (உற்றிடும் பூதத்து உணர்வு தோன்றிடும், 266) and Sivavakkiyar asks whether the jiva is அஞ்சு பஞ்ச பூதமோ. On the rhetorical-denial reading the conflict holds, but it is the generic soul-versus-materialism opposition, which the epic itself already holds against its refuted speaker; the Siddhar's வெட்டவெளி answer is not set against anything specific in the unit.

Neelakesi 45 gives the demons' complaint: he says feeding them பலி with meat is பாவம், and they weep 'you are our refuge' (அபயம்). That fills out 8's compressed கடவுள் புகல் நீக்குதல், so the obscure prologue phrase is shown to mean the stopping of blood offerings.

The shared omens are real: குடையொடு கோல்வீழ and கடுங்கதிர் மீன் ... வீழும் in the dream; ஒருமீன் விழுந்தன்று and காவல் வெண்குடை கால்பரிந்து in 229. But teaches calls 229's omen an after-the-fact proof: there the star falls first and the poet fears (அஞ்சினம்) for seven days before the death, so it is already a warning before the event.

The materialist's dismissal, தெய்வ மயக்கினும் கனா உறு திறத்தினும் மையல் உறுவார் (281-282), is answered by 9.8-11, where she knows her birth வழு இன்று and says மயக்கு அற உணர்ந்தேன். A claim and the scene that refutes it, with the very word மயக்கு reversed.
links.text_issue: Speakers of 278-283 are unnamed in the Tamil; the attribution is inferred.

links.reason: Kannaki's dream (காவலன் முன்னர்யான் கட்டுரைத்தேன் காவலனோடு ஊர்க்குஉற்ற தீங்கும் ஒன்று உண்டு, 9.50-51) is fulfilled here when she speaks before the king and he falls. Teaches rightly notes the city's harm in the dream is still to come.

Neelakesi 858 has the elements combining (ஐந்துங் கூடி) and awareness arising by the power of liquor's intoxication (மதுமயக்கு ஆற்றலின்), the same simile as மதுக் களி பிறந்தாங்கு (265), in the பூத வாதச் சருக்கம். A distinctive shared image across Buddhist and Jain polemic, as stated.

289 only says ஐவகைச் சமயமும் அறிந்தனள்; Tirumular says ஆறு சமயமும் கண்டவர் கண்டிலர். Neither makes a survey 'a stage to pass through' in these lines, and the six sects of 1533 are not shown to be the epic's five; it is a shared theme of sects found wanting, and the gain of a 'detailed record' assumes the lists match.

Kaathai 26 prescribes the method: அவ்வவர் சமயத்து அறி பொருள் கேட்டு மெய் வகை இன்மை நினக்கே விளங்கிய பின்னர் பிடக நெறி கடவாய், and she takes வேற்று உரு. At 27.277-278 she has heard எல்லா மார்க்கமும் and finds them நன்று அல: the instruction is carried out, as teaches says.

எல்லாம் உணர்ந்தான் and வாலறிவன் both make knowledge the mark of the god, but this is agreement on a common epithet type, not a qualification. The other-side gain says the poem 'reads' the couplet's epithet, which nothing in Neelakesi 1 shows.

16.220-221 gives the narrator's venba: வளையாத செங்கோல் வளைந்ததே பண்டை விளைவாகி வந்த வினை. Here the king names only his act, பொன்செய் கொல்லன் தன்சொற் கேட்ட யானோ அரசன் யானே கள்வன். The contrast between karma in the narrator's voice and self-blame in the king's is in the Tamil; 'refuse' is a slight overstatement of his silence about karma.

The logician lists உவமம், ஆகம அளவை (போக புவனம் உண்டு), அருத்தாபத்தி and others as separate means; 29.55-56 answers ஏனை அளவைகள் எல்லாம் ... அனுமானம் ஆம். A claim and its later answer within the epic, correctly typed.

The note says the unit has Brahma-vadin, Vaishnava and Saiva naming makers; the Saiva speaks at 86-95, outside this unit, which has the பிரம வாதி, the reciter of கடல்வணன் புராணம், and the வேதியன் on the Veda. Tirumular's three gods (Siva, Vishnu, Brahma) are thus not all present, and no quarrel among the speakers is staged (they are heard in turn and rejected at 107), so the other-side gain is untrue.

தேரா மன்னா (60) against தேர்ந்துசெய்வஃதே முறை is a real, specific link. But the qualification depends on the narrator's 'hour of karma' (16.148), outside this unit; here ஊழ்வினை துரப்ப (69) drives Kovalan to Madurai, not the king's failure to inquire.

The chain from மான் (mahat) matches: மான் என்று உரைத்த புத்தி வெளிப்பட்டு அதன்கண் ஆகாயம் ... வாயு (207-209) and மானின்கண் வானாகி வாயு வளர்ந்திடும். The epic's fuller statement helps the uncertain Tirumanthiram verse, and the dispute over cause (self-unfolding vs a படைத்தல் chapter) is accurately put.

ஆதி இல்லாப் பரமாணுக்கள் (126) against புக்கிருந்த பூதமும் புலன்களும் அனாதிஅல்ல and ஆத்துமம் அனாதிஅல்ல: incompatible claims on what is beginningless, on the reading that பூதம் covers the material elements. The note correctly gives the Ajivika view as his, not the epic's.

The materialist explains away கனா and தெய்வ மயக்கு as a changed mind (281-283); Neelakesi 885 demands how his பூதங்கள் account for கனவு, மந்திரம், சோதிடம், புட்குரல். Dream is used for and against the materialist, and teaches correctly assigns the Manimekalai view to the opponent.

The Ajivika's கருவில் பட்ட பொழுதே கலக்கும் ... முன் உள ஊழே பின்னும் உறுவிப்பது (162-164) flatly conflicts with ஊழையும் உப்பக்கம் காண்பர் ... உஞற்றுபவர். The view is correctly treated as a rival's, and the reference to 380 is accurate.

29.47 ஆதி சினேந்திரன் supports reading சினன் at 81 as the Buddha's teacher. But the claim that the logician pairs the Buddhists with two means rests on a cumulative reading of 78-85 that the list does not state (it gives six schools, six teachers and six means without pairing them).

The eight forms are shared (இரு சுடரோடு இயமானன் ஐம் பூதம் / எண்வகைமூர்த்தி, நிலநீர்தீவளி அகல்வான்). But Pattinathar scorns the அறுதொழிலாளர் and those whirling in சொற்பொருள் வண்மை who fail to read the signs, not Saiva debaters; the epic's Saiva disputant is not 'such disputants at work', so the other-side gain fails.
The dream's குடையொடு கோல்வீழ (2) is fulfilled the same hour in தாழ்ந்த குடையன் தளர்ந்தசெங் கோலன் (83). A dream and its event, accurately noted.

அரைசியல் பிழைத்தோர்க்கு அறம்கூற்று ஆவதூஉம் (0.55) returns as அல்லவை செய்தார்க்கு அறங்கூற்றம் ஆம் with பல்லவையோர் சொல்லும் பழுதன்றே, so the patikam's thesis is called a received saying now proved, as teaches says.

Kural 745 defines a good fort (கொளற்கரிதாய்க் கொண்டகூழ்த்தாகி); 44 shames a king who neither yields nor fights while his fort starves (பாலில் குழவி அலறவும்). These are different situations, and the starving fort lacks the stored food the couplet requires, so the two rather agree; the note's own hedge shows the tension needs a constructed reading.

புள்ளுறு புன்கண் தீர்த்தோன் (62) repeats Purananuru 37's புள்ளுறு புன்கண் தீர்த்த, the praise of the Chola ancestor. Kannaki of Puhar turns it into a precedent before a Pandya; both gains are true and specific.

The logician's perception grasps தேசம் நாமம் சாதி குணம் கிரியை (23-24); Aravanar's teaching gives சுட்டுணர்வைப் பிரத்தியக்கம் and விட்டனர் நாம சாதி குணம் கிரியைகள், moving them to அனுமானம் (49-51). The same list is answered item by item.

The king's கெடுகவென் ஆயுள் after confessing he heeded the goldsmith matches தானே கெடும் for the king who ஓரா முறைசெய்யா. Teaches and gains rightly isolate the failure to examine from accessibility (Kannaki is admitted at once, 55).

வயவேந்தன் றேவி / கடுவினையேன் recur as கோவேந்தன் தேவி கொடுவினை யாட்டியேன் at 21.1, and 21.3-4 (முற்பகற் செய்தான் பிறன்கேடு ...) carries the threat into the vow. This fixes the venba's speaker and addressee, as teaches says.

Both turn back the two deeds: வரு வழி இரண்டையும் மாற்றி ... அனுபவித்து அறுத்திடுதல் அது வீடு and இருவினை மாற்றிட்டு by setting the Lord's feet in mind. The pair is accurately read, but release by exhausting karma through one's own labour against release by holding the Lord is an incompatible claim, so tension fits better than qualifies.

9.1 தவந்தன்னைக் கலக்ககில்லா is told at length in 55: none of the beasts frighten him (வெருளான்) and she gives up, saying his தவநிறை சுடும். The prologue's bare failure becomes the penance's active power, which teaches names.

Both use the moon's spot (மதிக்கண் மறுப்போல் / வெண்டிங்கள் தானும் விமலம் தனக்கு இல்லது). But Kural 957 warns that a fault in the well-born shows; the Neelakesi asks indulgence for a poem's faults. The couplet raises no worry about rejection, so neither 'answers the worry' nor 'softens the warning' is true.

4.2-3 பெரியோன் அறங் கொண்ட பின்னைத் தீநீல உள்ளம் திரிந்து is expanded in 148: நன்ஞானம் நானும் கொண்டேன் and a request for பிராயச்சித்தம் for her wrong. The answer, to teach the சினவரன் நெறி in the land, is itself 4.4's turning the world from மறம், so the link is stronger than the note says.

The hero-stone rite is shared and specific: செம்பூங் கண்ணி bound with மரல் fibre in 264, செம்பூங் கரந்தை புனைந்த கண்ணி with ஆர்நார் and பல்பெயர் மண்ணி in 269. But teaches says the akam poet borrows the rite 'almost item by item' to fill the heroine's fear: the items differ (peacock feather vs turmeric), the stones line the road the man has already crossed, and the friend is comforting her on his return.

வினைவிளை காலம் ஆதலின் ... தேரான் ஆகி (16.148-149) in the narrator's voice, and தேரா மன்னா (60) beside ஊழ்வினை துரப்ப (69) in Kannaki's. The same failure is given both causes, and teaches states this exactly.
289 ஐவகைச் சமயமும் அறிந்தனள் is completed by 29.43-44 அவ் உரு என்ன ஐ வகைச் சமயமும் செவ்விது அன்மையின் சிந்தையின் வைத்திலேன், which names the assumed form too. The survey becomes a stated rejection.

The same example is shared: நினக்கு இவர் தாயும் தந்தையும் என்று பிறர் சொலக் கருதல் is filed as நினைப்பு, a false semblance, and 284 says தந்தை தாயரை அனுமானத்தால் அலது ... அறிவாய். But the logician's fault lies in taking it on others' word காரணம் நிகழாது, without ground, while Manimekalai calls it grounded inference; the two can stand together, and nothing marks her answer as a correction of him.

claims.gist: even a bird's speech is taken as meaningful, so a world that seeks virtuous dharma will accept a good word and not reject it as contemptible

claims_rejected.why: the conditional (அறம் வேண்டும் என்றால்) is the poet's plea for his book, part of the same claim, not a second one

units.note: Line 3 has a stray encoding mark (திறத்த.:) for ஃ.

claims.gist: our lord is the god worshipped by the Indras
the categories of the lord's teaching are dharma, adharma, time, space, soul, atoms, good and bad deeds, the bondage they cause, and release
things are permanent in their own nature and impermanent in their dependent forms
in each instant a thing has origination, persistence and destruction

claims_rejected.why: தீது இல் சீவன் is an epithet within the list, not a separate claim about the soul

units.note: Stance taken as refuted because the chapter sets out each school to be rejected (cf. 29.43-44), though no answer falls within these lines.

claims.gist: the categories are six: substance, quality, action, generality, particularity and inherence
substance, having quality and action, is the cause of all compounds, and is nine: earth, water, fire, wind, space, direction, time, self and mind
earth has all five qualities (sound, touch, colour, taste, smell); the other four elements have fewer
the qualities of substance include sound, touch, colour, smell, taste, size, weight, softness, shape and the rest
generality gives substance and quality their reality for producing action; atoms combine, and quality inheres in what has it

claims_rejected.why: lines 259-260 (போதலும் நிற்றலும் ... சாதலும் நிகழ்தலும்) are too compressed to separate from the account of generality
that those who have drunk his dharma need no naming is praise, not a doctrinal claim

claims.gist: inference is the means that knows the nature of the thing inferred
inference is of three kinds: from the common, from the remainder (effect to cause), and from the cause
inference knows the unseen through the seen, by a reason belonging to any of the three times

claims_rejected.why: the elephant-sound, flood and rain-cloud cases are illustrations of the kinds, not further claims
the poet's account of being made clear by the god's word is a personal statement about his book, not a doctrinal claim

claims.gist: atoms take on the functions of earth, water, fire and wind only when combined
a single atom is perceived only by those with divine sight; others see only masses of atoms
beings pass through six births (black, dark blue, green, red, golden, white) in order and reach release in the pure white birth
this is the straight course; deviating from it is the round of births (மண்டலம்)

claims_rejected.why: the single hair unseen at dusk is an illustration of the atom claim

claims.gist: the lord is the boundless knower who pervades all things everywhere and always
the categories are five: the soul and four kinds of atoms
the atoms of earth, water, fire and wind combine and separate, massing into mountains, trees and bodies
what knows these is called the soul

claims_rejected.why: Manimekalai's question to the Ajivika, not a claim
the king's death at the sight of her is narrated (illustrated), not stated as a general claim

units.note: பாவியேன் makes the speaker first person but unnamed.

claims_rejected.why: வருவதோர் துன்பமுண்டு is the queen's prediction from her dream, not a stated general claim about omens
